note: Node Keep adds boolean base fields node_keeper (block deletion) and, with Pathauto enabled, alias_keeper (block alias change) to every node, enforced by hook_node_access() for users lacking 'administer node_keep per node'. Global config node_keep.settings has one key hide_warning_messages; per-content-type defaults are node.type.* third-party settings under node_keep. This site has pathauto enabled so alias_keeper exists. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real node base-field values and the node_keep.settings config, using namespaced Article nodes (title 'NK ...').

evals.prompt: Using the Node Keep module on a Drupal site, how do you stop editors from deleting a specific node, and which permission lets a user override that protection and still delete it?
evals.expected_output: Tick 'Prevent this node from being deleted' (the node_keeper base field) on the node's edit form (Node keep section) or set node_keeper=1 in code. Users with the 'administer node_keep per node' permission (or core 'bypass node access') can still delete it; everyone else is blocked by hook_node_access().

evals.prompt: Node Keep shows a 'limited access permissions' warning message on protected nodes' edit pages. Which configuration setting hides that warning, in which config object, and at what admin path is its form?
evals.expected_output: Enable node_keep.settings.hide_warning_messages (the 'Hide warning messages' checkbox) at /admin/config/content/node-keep (route node_keep.settings, permission 'administer node_keep').

evals.prompt: With Node Keep, how do you make every newly created node of a given content type deletion-protected by default? Where is that default stored?
evals.expected_output: On the content type's edit form use the 'Node keep defaults' section and tick the node_keeper default. It is stored as a third-party setting on node.type.<bundle> under node_keep (node_keeper) and applied as the base-field-override default value for that bundle.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site one Article node has been marked as deletion-protected with Node Keep. Inspect the live site and give the title of the node whose node_keeper field is enabled.
evals.expected_output: The node titled 'NK Protected Probe' has node_keeper = 1 (query nodes where node_keeper = 1).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is Node Keep currently configured to show or to hide the 'limited access permissions' warning message on protected nodes? Inspect the live configuration and state the value of the relevant setting.
evals.expected_output: node_keep.settings.hide_warning_messages is TRUE, so the warning is hidden (read with `drush cget node_keep.settings hide_warning_messages`).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is an Article node titled 'NK Task Node'. Using Node Keep, protect it so that users without the 'administer node_keep per node' permission cannot delete it. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the node_keeper base field to TRUE on the 'NK Task Node' Article node and save it (e.g. $node->set('node_keeper', TRUE)->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site (which has Pathauto enabled) there is an Article node titled 'NK Alias Node'. Using Node Keep, lock this node's URL alias so unauthorized users cannot change it. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the alias_keeper base field (added by Node Keep because Pathauto is enabled) to TRUE on the 'NK Alias Node' Article node and save it (e.g. $node->set('alias_keeper', TRUE)->save()).
